gaps.hint: noun: the state of being free from rule
gaps.explanation: 'Gain independence' = become self-governing; the noun form follows the verb.
'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: The committee reached its verdict after lengthy ___ (DELIBERATE).
gaps.explanation: 'After lengthy deliberation' — the noun for careful discussion.

gaps.sentence: The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.
We've received your ___ (REQUEST) for a refund.
This shop offers a wide ___ (SELECT) of cheeses.
gaps.explanation: 'A selection of' = a range of items to choose from.

gaps.sentence: Do not be ___ (PATIENT) with the trainees — everyone learns at a different pace.
gaps.explanation: 'Do not be impatient' — the negative adjective fits the advice against frustration.
